title: Minimax optimal dual control of positive systems: an exact solution for scalar input-sign uncertainty
summary: While recent advances in minimax dual control have led to exact solutions for uncertain general linear time-invariant systems as well as (sub)optimal dual controllers, corresponding results for linear positive systems are still lacking. This paper aims to fill this gap and thereby pave the way toward scalable dual control algorithms. We study the general minimax optimal dual control problem for positive linear systems with unknown dynamics and reformulate it as a standard zero-sum dynamic game.
